claims.statement: CERTIFIED (held-out cross-organism, scoped; NOT Window6, NOT causal): the codon-E1 component of the synonymous codon-usage residual is CONSERVED across organisms. Per organism r_o = ||P_B1 d_resid4,o||^2 / ||d_resid4,o||^2; the clade-weighted statistic T_heldout = (1/18) sum over genera of the within-genus mean r_o (equal weight per genus to defuse pseudo-replication -- Burkholderia 7 + Mycobacterium 4 of the 29).
